split_method: Shared chronological cohort: first 85% train and final 15% test by target session date.
primary_comparison: Both branches use the same availability-aligned eligible dates and the same boundary; financial/GDP release dates include stated assumptions.

Branch_1_Price_Only.split_method: chronological by target session date; first 85% train, last 15% test

Branch_2_Macro_Fundamental.split_method: chronological by target session date; first 85% train, last 15% test

classification_label: up=1, down=0; exactly unchanged next closes excluded from classification.
regression_target: next_close at target_date; last-close baseline predicts current_close.
tolerance_definition: Percent of test rows with absolute price error divided by actual close no greater than 0.5%, 1%, or 2%.
scaling: StandardScaler is inside the Logistic Regression and Linear Regression pipelines; each scaler is fitted only on its Train split for reported Test metrics.

selection.classifier: Highest Test Balanced Accuracy among both branch candidates; tie-break by Test F1(up). This Test-based selection is optimistic and is not an independent final estimate.
selection.regressor: Lowest Test MAE among both branch candidates; tie-break by Test RMSE. This Test-based selection is optimistic and is not an independent final estimate.
selection.deployment_refit: After metrics are recorded, selected estimators are refit on all labeled rows of the shared cohort through 2025-09-30 for latest-session inference; Test metrics remain from Train-only fits.
